selection_rationale: M11 is the only surviving original mechanism: it attacks the missing quantifier c=c(q) while retaining full cap-depth information, and its relaxed c>=2 theorem passed independent audit. M12 was killed after reconstructing the actual Macaulay orbit interface: ranks are checked independently and there is no shared token-to-rank capacity graph on which its Hall formulation could act. The actual remaining bridge is the c=1 chamber recovery lemma recorded in evidence/C1_TWO_ROW_RECOVERY_NORMAL_FORM.json, not a capacity-flow theorem.
